conventions: One massless down-quark loop with L-1 gluon rungs, native qcd.json rules, Feynman gauge, tr_Dirac(1) = 4, SU(3), G = 1. Each input is the graph numerator N with Pi = delta_ab (g_munu q^2 - q_mu q_nu) N^{ab,munu} / [8 (d-1)], d = 4 - 2 eps, over the L-loop graph with all propagators at power 1, so that Pi/(q^2)^2 is the transverse form factor. `stripped_phase` is the constant phase of the numerator left out of the input.
